summary: Twelve days to Expo on Nov 4. Retry queue and duplicates fix are live, and the sync alert is done. Slot picker PR #241 awaits Sam's design review, which also blocks demo screen 3. Sam still needs Maya's pricing numbers, promised today. Harbor QBR went well.

items.text: Retry queue (TW-104) is live in production. The duplicates root-cause fix (TW-103) shipped, and PR #238 was approved.
Slot picker build is up as PR #241 and cannot merge until Sam completes the design review (TW-141, no due date).
Demo screen 3 waited on the slot picker build, which is now PR #241 in review. Screens 1 and 2 are done. TW-119 is due Oct 30.
Dry run put the full booth demo at 2:40. Sam wants it under two minutes.
Leila says the slot picker must be stable by Oct 28 for the booth tablet. TW-117 is due Oct 29. Error states (TW-135) are in progress.
Sam still needs Maya's final pricing numbers, promised for today. Maya said the one-pager and pricing page (TW-125) must use the same numbers.
Harbor QBR is done and Dana's team was positive. Maya shared the renewal terms there (TW-136 done). Harbor renews Oct 30 (38% of revenue).
Dana wants written notes from the QBR. TW-139 is due today.
Dana asked at the QBR for a 4-week dock trend in Harbor's weekly report. TW-140 is owned by Sam, with no due date.
Harbor's ops lead wants the same sync alerts we get, sent to their ops channel. The error-rate alert (TW-105) is live. TW-142 has no due date.
Ridgeline is yellow health and renews Nov 20 (22% of revenue) after a third double-booking incident this quarter. The duplicates fix shipped today. Renewal prep TW-113 is due Nov 13.
Valley's data is flowing and its Smart Slots setup starts Monday. Coastal is live in staging. TW-121 is due Oct 30.
Coastal and Valley need endpoint docs before going live. TW-127 is in progress, due Oct 26.
Pinecrest live demo is Monday. A third signed design partner is still needed by launch. TW-126 is due Oct 30.
Arjun created TW-143: load test the scoring API at 10x booth traffic, owned by Nina, due Oct 30. Scoring API TW-115 is due Oct 28, with load testing next.
Smart Slots suggestions look off for Coastal's early-morning docks. Nina's TW-138 is now in progress, due Oct 28.
Maya says the October investor update (TW-111) is being sent today. It was due today.
Expo invites go out today. The 40-account lead list (TW-122) is in progress, due Oct 28.
Arjun's second backend candidate interview is at 3pm today (TW-110). He reviews all backend PRs.
Smart Slots remains the company focus until Expo on Nov 4. Sync work was deferred unless sync worsened.
